subject: Human Body
title: Skin Cancer
description: A quick win: understand Skin Cancer.

hook.text: Skin cancer is the most common cancer worldwide. Most cases are caused by UV radiation damaging skin cell DNA.

buildup.text: Basal cell and squamous cell carcinomas are common and rarely lethal.

discovery.text: Melanoma starts in melanocytes. A mole that changes shape, color, or size may be melanoma.

twist.text: Five severe sunburns before age 20 double melanoma risk later in life.

climax.text: Most skin cancers are preventable with UV protection.

punchline.text: Childhood sunburns cause adult cancer. UV damage has a long memory.

quiz.question: What is the ABCDE rule used for?
options: Identifying suspicious moles that may be melanoma
